name: Pokémon Emerental
summary: A romhack of Pokemon Emerald that aims to offer a new experience by boasting a curated 'dex of 200+ Pokemon from all generations, most of them getting custom GBA style resprites. The main gimmick of the battles in Emerental is that all Pokemon now have a set 4 Moves that dictate their entire kit, and those moves power up with the 'mon's level. There are many QOL changes and new moves, abilities, stat reworks galore to play around with.
